prompt: Model the Maven default lifecycle so you can answer which phases a command runs and in what order. Complete LifecyclePhasePlanner, then run the tests.
explanation: Storing the lifecycle once as an ordered List turns every question into an index lookup: indexOf gives a phase its position, and -1 conveniently means "not a phase". phasesUpTo copies the prefix ending at that index, which is exactly Maven's rule that `mvn package` also runs validate, compile and test. sortPhases walks the canonical order and keeps the phases the caller mentioned, which sorts, de-duplicates and filters in a single pass without any Comparator.
hints: Declare the seven phases once as a private static final List<String> in lifecycle order -- every method can then use indexOf.
indexOf returns -1 for a name that is not a phase; that single check covers all three 'unknown name' rules.
For sortPhases, loop over the canonical list and keep the phases the input contains -- that automatically removes duplicates and unknown names.
